rodriguez-2020.citation: Rodríguez, Wineteer, Perkovic-Martin, Gál, Anderson, Zuckerman, Stear and Yang (2020), Ka-Band Doppler Scatterometry over a Loop Current Eddy, Remote Sensing 12(15), 2388.
rodriguez-2020.access: Original publisher-hosted PDF acquired and SHA-verified. Actual pages 6, 7 and 29–31 visually reviewed; Figure 2 native RGB image inspected and pixel-verified. PDF parser emitted color-space warnings on some operations; numeric comparison values are transcribed from readable source text, not inferred from affected color rendering. Raw ocean fields, model/front data and instrument profiles not acquired.

No observed boundary, east–west width, diameter, footprint or seasonal envelope inferred.
